description:
Resume a proof paused with pause_proof, by the same handle (ph_ctl_* / ph_dlg_*) or verification ID: it validates again everywhere, and a resumed delegation is honoured again by gated publishers on their next status check. Only the paused row flips back — a proof revoked while paused stays revoked, and a handle whose own row is not the paused one answers not_suspended. The API key needs proofs:write, plus delegations:write for a ph_dlg_*.

ACCESS: needs a Proof account. Authenticate this client (Claude Code: /mcp → Authenticate), then call this tool again. start_login does NOT open this tool.

id.description: Public proof handle (ph_ctl_* / ph_dlg_*) or verification ID

name: resume_proof

status.description: `suspended` after a suspend, `active` after an unsuspend

status_list_uri.description: The Token Status List where this change is published

suspended_at.description: When the suspension began; null after an unsuspend
